Lower Text: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by deleting 1 other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name, prevent that deletion.
Upper Text: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Chuumon], [Sukamon], or [Etemon] in its name among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
